errors.text_span: 四个不同模型（Lap14、Rest14、Twitter 和 Twitter）
errors.evidence: The legend shows only three models (Lap14, Rest14, Twitter), not four. The model 'Twitter' is listed twice.
The x-axis is labeled 'window size' and has no units specified in the figure. '组数' (groups) is a hallucinated unit.
The visible range of the y-axis in the figure is from 76% to 94%, not from 82% to 94%.

errors.text_span: 红色实线破折号点标记
errors.evidence: The Lap14 series is represented by a red solid line with circle markers. The description incorrectly identifies it as a 'solid dashed dot' line ('实线破折号点').

errors.text_span: Lap14 的红色实线破折号点标记在 x 轴上的 1.2% 和 82.4% 处，在 x 轴上的 3.4% 和 85.1% 处，在 x 轴上的 5.6% 和 86.2% 处，在 x 轴上的 7.8% 和 87.0% 处，在 x 轴上的 9.0% 和 86.9% 处；Rest14 的绿色虚线点标记在 x 轴上的 1.2% 和 85.5% 处，在 x 轴上的 3.4% 和 86.7% 处，在 x 轴上的 5.6% 和 87.3% 处，在 x 轴上的 7.8% 和 87.2% 处，在 x 轴上的 9.0% 和 86.2% 处；Twitter 的蓝色三角形标记在 x 轴上的 1.2% 和 78.2% 处，在 x 轴上的 3.4% 和 79.5% 处，在 x 轴上的 5.6% 和 80.4% 处，在 x 轴上的 7.8% 和 81.3% 处，在 x 轴上的 9.0% 和 80.1% 处。
errors.evidence: The description of data points is structurally nonsensical and numerically incorrect. It attempts to report coordinates by giving two percentage values for a location on the x-axis (e.g., '在 x 轴上的 1.2% 和 82.4% 处'). The x-axis represents 'window size' with integer values from 1 to 10, not percentages. This format completely misrepresents how to read data from the plot, and the numerical values themselves are not found in the chart.
The Rest14 series is represented by a green solid line with inverted triangle markers. The description incorrectly calls it a 'dashed dot' line ('虚线点').
The description mentions the color and marker for the Twitter series but omits its line style (solid).
